text: おれ　＊　さがしてるんだ！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now; in casual speech the い drops out and it becomes てる. さがしてる = 'am looking for'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end gives the feeling of explaining your situation to the listener. It is the spoken short form of のだ. さがしてるんだ = 'the thing is, I'm looking for it'.
